q1.explanationZh: run out of“用完；耗尽”，与 use up、finish 意思相同，如 We have run out of petrol.

q2.explanationZh: plenty of“大量的；很多的”，后面既可接可数名词，也可接不可数名词。

q3.explanationZh: one after another“一个接一个地”，常放在句末修饰动作。

q4.explanationZh: see sb. off“为某人送行”，人称代词要放在 see 和 off 中间：see you off。

q5.explanationZh: put off“延期；推迟”，put off doing sth. 表示“推迟做某事”。

q6.explanationZh: pay attention to“注意”，to 是介词，后面接名词、代词或动词 -ing 形式。

q7.explanationZh: put up“举起；挂起；张贴”，如 put up your hand（举手）、put up a notice（贴通知）。

q8.explanationZh: refer to“参考；涉及；指的是”，to 是介词，后面接名词。

q9.explanationZh: provide sb. with sth.“向某人提供某物”，也可以说 provide sth. for sb.。

q10.explanationZh: play with“玩耍；摆弄”，with 后面接玩的东西或玩伴，如 play with his ball。

q11.explanationZh: out of“从……里出来”，如 go out of the room；也可表示“缺乏”，如 run out of。

q12.explanationZh: play a trick on sb.“捉弄某人”，on 后面接被捉弄的人。

q13.explanationZh: pay for“付……钱；买”，常用 sb. pay (money) for sth.，与 spend…on、cost 可以互换。

q14.explanationZh: save one’s life“挽救某人生命”，one’s 在句中要换成具体的物主代词，如 save her life。

q15.explanationZh: point out“指出”，后面可以接名词或 that 从句。

q16.explanationZh: out of date“过时的”，常用 be out of date，反义是 up to date。

q17.explanationZh: praise sb. for sth.“因某事表扬某人”，for 后面接表扬的原因。

q18.explanationZh: put on“穿上；戴上”，强调“穿”的动作；也可表示“上演”。

q19.explanationZh: pick up“捡起；拾起”，宾语是代词时要放中间：pick it up。

q20.explanationZh: once more 和 once again 都表示“再一次”，两个都可以。

q21.explanationZh: prepare for“为……做准备”，for 后面接要准备的事，如 prepare for the exam。

q22.explanationZh: pick out“挑选出”，如 pick out the bad potatoes。

q23.explanationZh: prevent sb. from doing sth.“阻止某人做某事”，from 后面接动词 -ing 形式，与 stop…from、keep…from 意思相同。

q24.explanationZh: put out“扑灭（火）”，如 put out the fire。

q25.explanationZh: run away“逃跑”，过去式是 ran away。

q26.explanationZh: “再三；一次次”= over and over，相当于 again and again。

q27.explanationZh: “拾起”= pick up；“拿错了”是过去发生的事，用过去式 picked up。

q28.explanationZh: “挑选出”= pick out；Let’s 后面用动词原形。

q29.explanationZh: “比起……更喜欢”= prefer A to B，to 是介词，后面接动词 -ing 形式 going；主语 I 用 prefer。

q30.explanationZh: “提供”= provide…with（答案页给出 provide…with）；这里 provide help with pronunciation 表示“在发音方面提供帮助”；can 后用动词原形 provide。

q31.explanationZh: “阻止……做”= prevent…from，prevent 和 from 之间要有宾语，这里“阻止自己”用 ourselves；from 后接动词 -ing 形式 eating，should 后用动词原形 prevent。书末答案印作 prevent from（缺宾语），经人工复核（GitHub #135 第 137 条）更正为 prevent ourselves from。

q32.explanationZh: “依靠”= rely on，can 后用动词原形 rely。

q33.explanationZh: “逃跑”= run away；看见强盗是过去的事，用过去式 ran away。

q34.explanationZh: “搜寻”= search…for…，表示“在某处搜寻某物”：search all the drawers for the paper；过去的事用过去式 searched。

q35.explanationZh: “为……送行”= see sb. off，代词 you 放在 see 和 off 中间；will 后用动词原形 see。

q36.sampleAnswer: Please put up your hand if you have any questions.
references: Please put up your hand if you have any questions.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q36.explanationZh: “举手”= put up your hand；“如有问题”用 if 引导的条件状语从句，祈使句以 Please 开头。

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q37.explanationZh: “丰富的想象力”= plenty of imagination，imagination 是不可数名词，plenty of 可以修饰。

q38.sampleAnswer: The teacher praised him highly for his honesty.
references: The teacher praised him highly for his honesty.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q38.explanationZh: “因某事表扬某人”= praise sb. for sth.，sb. 用宾格 him；“高度”= highly；过去的事用 praised。

q39.sampleAnswer: He wanted to save her life at all cost.
references: He wanted to save her life at all cost.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q39.explanationZh: “挽救她的生命”= save her life（one’s 换成 her）；“不惜一切代价”= at all cost。

q40.sampleAnswer: I prefer playing sports outdoors to watching TV at home.
references: I prefer playing sports outdoors to watching TV at home.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q40.explanationZh: “宁愿做 A 也不愿做 B”= prefer doing A to doing B，to 后面用动词 -ing 形式 watching。

q41.sampleAnswer: The students in our school are busy preparing for our School Art Festival.
references: The students in our school are busy preparing for our School Art Festival.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q41.explanationZh: “忙着做某事”= be busy doing sth.，所以用 preparing for；“艺术节”= Art Festival。

q42.sampleAnswer: Trees should be well protected from the cold during winter.
references: Trees should be well protected from the cold during winter.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q42.explanationZh: “保护……免受”= protect…from；树木是“被保护”，用被动语态 should be protected from the cold。

q43.sampleAnswer: He pointed out that there was little chance of success.
references: He pointed out that there was little chance of success.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q43.explanationZh: “指出”= point out，后接 that 从句；“机会渺茫”= there was little chance of success。

q44.sampleAnswer: The firemen fought bravely and put out the forest fire in the end.
references: The firemen fought bravely and put out the forest fire in the end.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q44.explanationZh: “扑灭”= put out；“最终”= in the end；过去的事用一般过去时 fought、put。

q45.sampleAnswer: We’ve decided to put off the spring outing till next week because of the bad weather.
references: We’ve decided to put off the spring outing till next week because of the bad weather.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q45.explanationZh: “推迟”= put off；“已经决定”用现在完成时 have decided to do；“因为天气不好”= because of the bad weather。
